title: Notification of RY 2025 Medicaid Improper Payment Rates — Minnesota
supports: CMS measured Minnesota's RY2025 Medicaid overall improper-payment rate at 2.16% based on a 900-review sample covering payments from July 2023 through June 2024.
CMS explicitly warns that improper payments do not necessarily represent expenses that should not have occurred and may include documentation or enrollment-process errors.
CMS defines some technically improper payments as payments to the right recipient for the right amount for which recovery is not required.
The managed-care component rate was 0.00% in the PERM sample, but this measures the PERM managed-care component and does not establish an absence of provider fraud inside managed-care plans.
does_not_support: The 2.16% improper-payment rate is not a fraud rate.
The PERM sample and methodology do not validate or refute the separate prosecutor $9 billion fraud estimate/hypothesis.
The 0% managed-care PERM component does not measure all underlying managed-care provider claims for fraud.
PERM and CMS's January 2026 program-integrity noncompliance determination concern different methods, periods, scopes and questions and should not be treated as mutually exclusive.
